description: Defines the AudioPeakingFilter class for a peaking audio filter with configurable parameters, using underlying biquad filtering and coefficient interpolation.

classes.name: AudioPeakingFilter
classes.description: A class implementing a peaking audio filter with controllable frequency, gain, and bandwidth, utilizing biquad filtering and coefficient interpolation.

methods.name: AudioPeakingFilter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes and resets the filter.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Reconfigures the filter with new channel and sample rate settings.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets filter parameters to default values and disables the filter.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Clears delay lines without changing parameters.

methods.name: setGain
methods.description: Sets gain in millibel, actual change applied on commit.

methods.name: setBandwidth
methods.description: Sets bandwidth in cents, change applied on commit.

methods.name: setFrequency
methods.description: Sets frequency in millihertz, change applied on commit.

methods.name: getBandRange
methods.description: Retrieves the low and high frequency range in mHz.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Applies all parameter changes, optionally immediately.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes input buffer through the filter.

methods.name: enable
methods.description: Enables the filter to start processing.
